title: Audio8 Realistic: compact multilingual TTS and evaluation caveats

claims.text: The model card reports 601,159,424 main-model parameters, excluding the separate 44.1 kHz codec. It supports 23 languages, including Indonesian, and zero-shot voice cloning.
The listening page uses curated English and Chinese examples; it explicitly does not represent all languages or a blind preference test.
The serving validation used NVIDIA H20/BF16 with compilation and CUDA graphs disabled. It checked non-streaming API compatibility without benchmarking throughput or streaming.
The card identifies Apache 2.0 for code and model weights and links license and notice files.

limitations: Parameter-size conventions differ across the compared projects.
Publisher tests were not independently reproduced here.
gaps: Mac compatibility, throughput and listening quality remain untested.
